q28.

**Background workers actually started by the server** (`server/server.go`, `startBackgroundRunners`, lines 153-174, called from `Start` at line 129):

- s3presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) — started as a goroutine calling `Run(s3Context)`; internally driven by a `time.NewTicker(12 * time.Hour)` (`runnerInterval` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`), so it fires `RunOnce`/`CheckAndPresign` once immediately at startup (`server/server.go:163`) and then every 12 hours until its context is cancelled on shutdown.

**Unused scheduling infrastructure:**

- `internal/scheduler` — a full cron-style job scheduler package (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`, with doc comment in `internal/scheduler/doc.go:1-2` describing it as "a GitHub Actions-inspired cron job scheduler" supporting standard cron expressions, timezones, and middleware). It is exercised only by its own tests/examples (`internal/scheduler/scheduler_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`) — no import of `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/scheduler` exists anywhere in `server/` or `cmd/`, so the server never registers or runs any job through it.
- `server/runner/memopayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) also defines a `Runner` type with a batch `RunOnce` method meant to rebuild all memo payloads, but `server.go` never constructs or starts this `Runner`. The package's `RebuildMemoPayload` function is used, but only called synchronously/inline from request handlers in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (lines 108 and 447) on memo create/update — not as a scheduled or backgrounded job.
